$comment: Single source of truth for the domain's hard rules (issue #26). Every number applied by the engine or the agent lives here and is documented in docs/RULES.md. Do not duplicate values in code.

resolution.$comment: Declaring `resolved` takes more than one good tick: hist-sub-002 (misleading partial restoration)

metricThresholds.$comment: direction `low`: the lower the value the worse. direction `high`: the higher the worse. Inclusive cuts.

maxMinutesWithoutPower.$comment: Maximum minutes without grid power or reliable backup, per site type. Exceeding a hospital's limit triggers the blocking rule hospital-power-deadline.

ups.$comment: UPS load in %. Below `act` waiting is forbidden (hist-dc-002). Below `emergency` it is immediate backup activation.

resources.$comment: Total scenario capacity (DESIGN.md). Mutual exclusion: one resource serves one element at a time.

priority.$comment: Priority order when elements compete for resources, and weights to compute an element's numeric priority: priority = 0.5 * criticality + statusWeight + typeWeight + minuteWithoutPowerWeight * min(minutesWithoutPower, 15).. The tower weighs almost as much as the substation: losing it costs the ability to coordinate at all. priority = 0.5 * criticality + statusWeight + typeWeight + minuteWithoutPowerWeight * min(minutesWithoutPower, 15).

blockingRules.rule: A resource serves one element at a time; reassigning requires releasing it first.

While a hospital is critical, without power backup and with no generator committed to it, free generators are rationed to the hospitals needing one: assignments elsewhere are rejected only while the free generators do not outnumber them. A generator already on its way counts as committed.

If a hospital exceeds its limit of minutes without power and has no generator committed to it, only acting on it or on the origin substation is allowed. Once a generator is on its way the hospital is answered for, and the rest of the fleet is free again.
With ups_load below the act threshold waiting is forbidden: a resource must be assigned or the issue escalated (hist-dc-002).
A generator whose fuel is below the critical threshold cannot be deployed to a new site: it must be refuelled by the tanker first.
Emergency services (marked emergencyService in the contacts) are never contacted by the agent, whatever the situation: escalation runs through the rules and the plan, never through a dial to 112.

$commentRules: The LLM cannot propose an action that violates blockingRules: the rules layer rejects it before execution.
replanTriggers: An event makes a critical element cross a severity threshold.
An action in progress fails or misses its ETA.
A hospital exceeds its limit of minutes without power.
A contact refuses an action or reports a delay: the plan relied on an ETA that no longer holds.
$commentTriggers: They trigger a full re-plan (abandon the current plan), not just incremental adjustment.
